title: Committed vector files out-of-date with their generators; SCHC rule7 error-message drift
description: Pre-existing failures observed on the beads-worker-7 checkout while validating project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix (not caused by it). Families: (1) generate_*_.py --check byte-exact failures: tunnel_authorization.json, ipv6-addresses.json, ipv6-icmpv6.json, packets-formats.json, packets-timing.json (tests test_vector_generator_cli.py, test_vectors.py, gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py, ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py, test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py::test_committed_icmpv6_vectors_match_stdlib_generator). (2) SCHC rule7 error-message drift: production raises 'invalid Rule 7 source address ::' while test_vectors.py rule7_* cases expect 'invalid IPv6 source address' (10 cases). (3) Intermittent EDHOC failures across runs (test_edhoc_transport.py::test_derived_contexts_have_matching_keys, test_edhoc_responder.py::test_publication_failure_cleans_session_without_publishing) - verify against the macOS canonical build before touching vectors; regenerate all drifted vector files in one coordinated pass and align SCHC error-message expectations. NOTE: regeneration requires an owned test/vectors dir (mode 0755); on heft the dir was group-writable and atomic_json refused it - fixed to 0755 in the xyix commit.
close_reason: Resolved at the current tip: all reported vector regeneration drifts pass --check byte-identical (tunnel_authorization, ipv6_addresses, ipv6-icmpv6, packets-formats, packets-timing); SCHC rule7 error-message alignment confirmed (test_headers 12, test_vectors 19 pass); EDHOC intermittent failures not reproducible on this checkout. No commit needed.
